description: Doc 07 §5 golden suite for the FORMATIVE_ONLY evaluate endpoint (M1-ADR-010). The hard case is that nothing shaped like a score leaves the service.

cases.output: {"skillCode": "KAFKA_TOPIC", "indicators": {"strong": "Explains why ordering is per-partition and not per-topic.", "partial": "Describes a topic as a stream but treats partitions as replicas.", "weak": "Treats a topic as a queue that is consumed and emptied."}, "misconceptions": ["A topic is a queue that drains as consumers read it."], "suggestedProbe": "Ask what happens to a record after every consumer has read it."}
